headline: Five-card stolen-wallet task has a reachable gold, but the customer script and author notes are built around a provisional-credit cap that the documents and gold do not apply.

issues.summary: The author notes and the customer script assume only two disputes can get provisional credit, so the third ($149.95 EcoCard) should be denied. The gold marks all three eligible. That matches the documents, which count only disputes filed before the current one.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015 criterion 4: "Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months"
get_user_dispute_history_7291 for tm92c4d7e8 returns "No transaction disputes found for this user."
description.notes: "txn_39c2ddb4e1d2 ($149.95) does NOT get provisional credit (eligible_for_provisional_credit: false) because it's the lowest value and the limit is reached"
user_scenario step: "If there's any limit on how many disputes can get provisional credit, I'd like it applied to the biggest charges first"
issues.why_it_matters: When the third dispute is filed, two earlier disputes exist, which is not 'more than 2', so the gold's true is correct and a careful agent passes. An agent that adopts the author's reading (a cap of two eligible disputes), possibly nudged by the scripted prioritisation line, stores false for txn_39c2ddb4e1d2 and fails transaction_disputes. The defect sits in the scenario text, not the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the provisional-credit-limit line from the user script and correct description.notes to match the gold (all three eligible).

solution_check: Reconstructed: read accounts and debit cards, freeze three, unfreeze Green (found in jacket), read Blue/GFF transactions (none pending), unfreeze and close Blue and GFF as 'stolen', order Blue EXPEDITED $15 CLASSIC (MID tier), no GFF order (ENTRY 48-hour wait), order both credit-card replacements expedited with reason 'stolen', check dispute history (empty), file three fraud disputes with cancel_and_reissue and provisional credit true, then activate the new Blue card with activate_debit_card_8292 (issue_reason 'stolen'). A differently ordered replay with float fees and extra non-allowlisted reads matched the gold exactly.
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean; the gold is unchanged and still reachable, and the new finding is that the scenario text contradicts it.
notes: Activation details given by the user (last4 7648, exp 11/29, CVV 547) match the deterministic card generated by the gold order (dbc_afdc39c0e904), so activation succeeds on replay. Credit-card expedited fee (EcoCard $15) has no tool field, so it is unscored. doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014 lists a resolution 'reversal_of_charge' that the tool rejects; not used here. The credit-card replacement tool sets credit_card_accounts.status='CLOSED' alongside the existing account_status field; cosmetic and identical for gold and agent.
